text:
Maria G: Hey all — midwinter lantern decorating tonight at 6 in the common area! Bring a snack or something glow-y. ✨ Lanterns, paper, tea lights provided. Also organizing a hot-drink poll: hot cider vs mulled wine vs hot chocolate. Vote with emoji below.
Jamal H: I'll bring extra batteries and glitter. :grin:
Sophie L: Hot chocolate all the way! :hot_chocolate: (vegan marshmallows if anyone asks)
Kevin T: Mulled wine for the win. Also can we please have a non-sparkly option for desks? 😂
Anya R: Cider + cinnamon sticks here. Also quick PSA: donation box for Toys4Kids will be by the door if you want to drop something.
Maria G: Added a pinned poll — react to the original message: :apple: cider, :wine_glass: mulled wine, :chocolate_bar: hot choc. Also there's a tiny lantern craft for kids if anyone wants to bring them.
Jamal H: Playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX0Yxoavh5qJV (holiday vibes) :notes:
Slackbot: Reminder — building closes at 9:00 PM tonight.
Kevin T: Big thanks to facilities — extra seating already set up. @FacilitiesTeam :thumbsup:
Sophie L: I'll bring vegan cookies and labels.
Anya R: Quick manual tally so far: cider 3, hot choc 1, mulled wine 2. Looks like cider is ahead! :apple:
Maria G: Awesome — cider it is. See you at 6! Photos encouraged but please no work screenshots. :camera_flash:
(reacts: :heart:, :thumbsup:, :sparkles:)
